messages.subject: revolution r open with visual studio community
parts: I am a financial trader and I would like to use Revolution R Open (RRO) with Visual Studio Community.  I am currently using C# within Visual Studio Community to build strategies.  I would like to utilize RRO to do some more complicated mathematical function within the script.  How can I load RRO and use RRO in Visual Studio so I can integrate RRO in to my scripts.

messages.author: 149440eddb848db9
messages.subject: Re: revolution r open with visual studio community
parts:
Hi, Alton

As far as I know, there is not yet any support for R in Visual Studio.

However, your immediate question is how to integrate R and C#.  This question was asked on StackOverflow (http://stackoverflow.com/questions/5377070/c-sharp-r-interface) and most of the answers point to the R.NET project (http://jmp75.github.io/rdotnet/).

I hope this helps.

Regards

Andrie
